what.text: This page follows refugees from Belarus living in Poland, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 11425 Belarusian refugees in Poland, 58.7% of all refugees from Belarus.
Poland is the largest host of Belarusian refugees, followed by the United States, Germany and France.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Belarus, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1997 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Poland.
These are year-end totals for Poland only, reported to UNHCR.
